description: This file defines the Manufacturer model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, containing methods to perform CRUD operations and manage related data for manufacturer entities in the database.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Model class for managing manufacturer data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving manufacturer records and related metadata like descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer record in the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts, then returns the new manufacturer ID.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Updates an existing manufacturer record and its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a manufacturer record in the database.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Deletes a manufacturer and its associated descriptions, store relations, layouts, and SEO URLs from the database.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific manufacturer by ID.

methods.name: getManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches a list of manufacturers based on provided filters such as name, store, status, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalManufacturers
methods.description: Returns the total number of manufacturers matching optional filters.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a manufacturer in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all manufacturer descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a manufacturer across different languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all manufacturer descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Removes store associations for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves store IDs associated with a manufacturer.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a manufacturer with a layout for a specific store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations of a manufacturer.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes manufacturer layout associations by layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes manufacturer layout associations by store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout associations for a manufacturer.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the count of layouts associated with a specific layout ID.
